The awaitable `writer` returns `persistReplace()` immediately for a persisted owner (has-one-association.ts:52-55 -- the Rails-faithful immediate persist); the sync property-setter `queueWrite`/new-owner path defers the same `persistReplace` to the owner's next save via `flushPendingReplaces`. Either way the save lands in `persistReplace`, not literally inside `replace`, so the extractor flags it -- false positive, no omission.
